heading: Home navigation system to enhance driver performance awareness and streamline task navigation

blocks.html: The Home screen serves as a Navigation hub, being the first thing users see when opening the app. Therefore, guiding drivers to their most critical tasks through the homepage, focusing their attention on the most important delivery data, is key to my design.
Three primary design questions informed my design strategy.
How can I structure the homepage for easy access to functions and other pages for drivers?
What is the most important information for drivers? The data information or navigation to other functions?
How to design the homepage to enhance drivers' performance awareness, thus improving the delivery rate?
